name: Portalcraft
description: Portal 2 and Minecraft in one world. The Minecraft half of Portalcraft: it runs next to the real Portal 2 and shares one world with it, so you can dig through chambers and walk through portals into Minecraft. Derived from SkyCraft by chasmlol.
contributors: SkyCraft (chasmlol), the architecture and much of this mod, MIT
